new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Palnadu Pullari (forest) satyagraha:
1. It took place in Palnadu, Guntur district, in 1921-22.
2. It was the first forest satyagraha in Andhra.
3. Its hero, Kanneganti Hanumanthu, was born in Nellore district.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: the Pullari satyagraha took place in Palnadu, Guntur district, in 1921-22 and was the first forest satyagraha in Andhra. Statement 3 is wrong: Kanneganti Hanumanthu was born in Guntur district. So 1 and 2 only (B); A misses statement 2, C and D include the false statement 3.
new.tq: Palnadu = Guntur; Hanumanthu = Guntur-born; first forest satyagraha

new.s: Who became the first woman President of the Indian National Congress, in 1917?
new.x: Annie Besant presided over the Congress in 1917 and was its first woman President. Sarojini Naidu (1925) was the first Indian woman President; Nellie Sengupta presided later (1933); Kasturba Gandhi never presided.
new.tq: First woman INC President = Besant 1917; first Indian woman = Sarojini 1925

new.s: The Non-Cooperation Movement was suspended at Bardoli in February 1922 because of violence at:
new.x: Gandhi suspended the NCM at Bardoli (11-12 February 1922) after a mob burnt a police station at Chauri Chaura in Gorakhpur district, UP. Minchalapadu and Macherla were sites of the Palnadu forest satyagraha, and Pedanandipadu was an Andhra no-tax centre; none of them caused the suspension.

new.s: The Belgaum session of the Indian National Congress (1924) is notable because:
o: It was the only Congress session presided over by Mahatma Gandhi
It adopted the Purna Swaraj resolution
It approved the suspension of the Non-Cooperation Movement
It was the first session presided over by a woman
new.x: Belgaum 1924 was the only INC session presided over by Gandhi, and it reunited the Swarajists and No-Changers. Purna Swaraj was adopted at Lahore (1929); the NCM was suspended at Bardoli (1922); the first woman President was Annie Besant (1917).

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Lahore session of the Congress (December 1929):
1. It was presided over by Motilal Nehru.
2. It resolved that 26 January be observed every year as Independence Day.
3. The tricolour was hoisted on the banks of the Ravi.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is wrong: the Lahore session was presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru (Motilal Nehru chaired the Nehru Report committee). Statements 2 and 3 are correct: 26 January was fixed as Independence Day (first observed on 26 January 1930) and Nehru hoisted the tricolour on the banks of the Ravi. So 2 and 3 only (C); A includes the false statement 1, B misses statement 3, D includes statement 1.
new.tq: Lahore 1929 = Jawaharlal presides; Nehru Report = Motilal
